title: STARTEX: Ghost Pumps — Infusion Pump Integrity and Clinical Trust

fields.location: Ottawa River Regional Medical Center, Toledo, Lucas County, Ohio
fields.load: Census: 326 inpatients; ED has 19 patients. ICU 3 North and 3 South are both at 100% capacity (16 patients each).
fields.staffing: Full on-call and shift staff across all units; AOC on duty in HCC.
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 14:20 on Thursday, March 12, 2026, at Ottawa River Regional Medical Center. At 14:17, the charge nurse in ICU 3 North reported that four patients had dropped from the central telemetry display on ORRMC-MON01. Their bedside monitors still show normal tracings. No alarm has been triggered. No incident has been declared. The system is running as expected, but the data is missing. The hospital remains in normal operations.

status.name: Central Telemetry Display (ORRMC-MON01)
status.note: Four ICU 3 North patients missing from display

status.name: ICU 3 North
status.note: All beds occupied; no alert from nursing staff

status.name: ICU 3 South
status.note: All beds occupied; no alert from nursing staff

status.name: Infusion Pump Network (10.40.x.x)
status.note: 41 pumps in ICU 3N, 3S, and 4E show library version 4.2.2

fields.facilitatorNote: Players must recognize the discrepancy between telemetry absence and stable bedside monitors. The hidden threat lies in the pump library change, not the telemetry. Watch for premature escalation or over-reliance on EHR or monitoring data.
